intro: Guatemala has volcanoes, highland lakes, rainforest and two coasts.

chapters.title: Volcanoes and lakes
text: A chain of volcanoes runs through the highlands; Tajumulco is the highest point in Central America, and Fuego erupts often. Lake Atitlán sits in a giant crater ringed by volcanoes. Petén in the north is lowland rainforest.

chapters.title: Land of eternal spring
text: The highlands are mild all year, while the lowlands are hot.

keyTerms.meaning: A large crater left by a volcano.
